//: Resolution shim, not a package. Metro in React Native 0.76 does not honour package.json "exports" by default (unstable_enablePackageExports is opt-in until ~0.79), so `@armemon-library/redux/persist` fails to resolve in an app bundle even though Node, Vite, Jest and TypeScript all resolve it fine from the exports map. This directory is the pre-exports way to expose a subpath: Metro resolves the folder and reads main/module here, while everything else keeps using exports. Confirmed by running a real `react-native bundle`.
name: @armemon-library/redux-persist
